_README: Local, offline pricing model for the Boltz-2 backend (run via Modal GPU
deployment per modal_proxy.py) — deliberately NOT a live API call. This
repo's own Security section guarantees zero outbound network calls
anywhere in the codebase, so pricing has to come from a local rate table
you fill in from your real Modal billing dashboard, not a fetch at
'rate_usd_per_gpu_second' is null on purpose — nobody should ship a
guessed dollar figure. Get the real number from your Modal account
(Settings -> Usage/Billing, or the per-GPU-type rate on modal.com/pricing
for whatever GPU class your deployment targets) and fill it in. Until
estimated_cost_usd: null, and callers must treat that as 'pricing not
starting points, not measured — replace them the first time you time a
handful of real Boltz runs end-to-end (modal logs show wall-clock GPU
time per call) and this file's calibration will actually mean something.
